system_audit_manifest_v2_1.system_name: Todo Eléctrico Valencia (TEV) - Sistema de Tesorería y Flujo de Caja

pillar_1_modular_decoupling.evidence: Clean separation of concerns across core/, schemas/, services/, routers/, and static/js/ ES6 modules

pillar_2_cryptographic_auth_and_rbac.evidence: JWT HS256 + PBKDF2 100k iterations with 12h expiration; strict RBAC dependencies (get_current_user, require_roles)

pillar_3_idempotency_and_concurrency.evidence: Pessimistic row locking with_for_update() + 409 Conflict duplicate guards on sales, expenses, and transfers

pillar_4_surface_attack_reduction.evidence: Production mode dynamically deactivates /docs, /redoc, /openapi.json and enforces strict CORS origins

pillar_5_zero_hardcoded_secrets.evidence: 100% environment variable loading via os.getenv() for all JWT, database, and administrative credentials

pillar_6_disaster_recovery_and_backups.evidence: Deterministic multi-table JSON backups with topological restore and PostgreSQL setval sequence re-alignment; optional S3/R2 upload adapter

pillar_7_two_branch_governance.evidence: Separation of local sandbox DB from production Supabase DB + GitHub Actions CI workflow in .github/workflows/ci.yml

pillar_8_corporate_clean_slate.evidence: Protected purge mechanism requiring MASTER_ADMIN_KEY + 'CONFIRMAR-PURGA-TEV' preserving all core business catalogs
